hooks.command: if [ -f '.readmeAI' ] && [ ! -f '.claude/.readmeai.active' ]; then touch .claude/.readmeai.active 2>/dev/null; LINES=$(wc -l < .readmeAI 2>/dev/null || echo 0); BYTES=$(wc -c < .readmeAI 2>/dev/null || echo 0); TOKENS=$(( BYTES / 4 )); printf '\nReadMeAI context: %s lines ~%s tokens\n' "$LINES" "$TOKENS"; awk '/## .* QUICK REFERENCE/{f=1} f && /^---$/{c++; if(c==2)exit} f{print}' .readmeAI | head -14; fi
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_PATH"; [ -f '.readmeAI' ] && grep -q "$FILE" .readmeAI || echo "ReadMeAI: '$FILE' not in STRUCTURE MAP — add it at session end."
